crossRefs.note: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
translations.bsb: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks.
translations.kjv: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
translations.asv: and he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
